texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_TUNDRA_ATACANTE_1: Snow and ice to the horizon, a few stunted trees and low ridges. Cross the frozen streams quickly: on the ice no horse can charge.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_TUNDRA_ATACANTE_2: The log settlement and its chapel by the frozen lake are our objective. Take them.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_TUNDRA_DEFENSOR_1: The enemy must cross the frozen streams in the open. Let the cold and our fire do the work.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_TUNDRA_DEFENSOR_2: Hold the settlement and its chapel. Out here they are the only shelter from the cold.
